_comment: ACTIVE project MCP configuration for My-AI-Tools — integrated from
config/claude/mcp/mcp.servers.json. Everyone opening this repo in Claude Code gets
these servers. Claude Code asks for approval before first use of each one.
Only the credential-free `playwright` server is enabled: repo-audit-fixer drives web
UIs with it during Phase 3, and Chromium is preinstalled in Claude Code web sessions.
The `_disabled_*` entries need a credential or a path — move one into `mcpServers` and
export its ${VAR} in your shell to enable it. Never inline a token into this committed
file; use ${VAR}, which Claude Code expands from the environment at launch.

_disabled_postgres._why: Read-only Postgres access. Lets an audit check the real schema — missing indexes, missing constraints, schema drift from the ORM models — instead of inferring it from code.
_disabled_postgres._setup: Create a role with SELECT only. Never point this at a production database holding personal or clinical data.

_disabled_filesystem._why: Scoped filesystem access outside the project directory — a shared datasets folder, for example.
_disabled_filesystem._setup: List only the directories that are genuinely needed. Each one is standing access.

_disabled_sqlite._why: Local SQLite files — common in analysis and prototype work.

_disabled_example_http_server._why: Shape of a remote MCP server reached over HTTP, with a token from the environment.
